title: TSMC Q3 profit surges more than expected to record high on AI-fueled demand
key_facts: TSMC reported third-quarter profit of $23.86 billion on Thursday 15 Oct 2026.
Earnings were $4.60 per share against an average estimate of $4.45.
Revenue was $46.72 billion against an estimate of $45.62 billion.
Reuters and CNBC headlines call it a sixth straight quarter of record profit on the AI boom.
Yahoo Finance had said investors expected quarterly profit to rise 60%.
investingLive said Nvidia and Apple are among TSMC's key customers.
quote_evidence: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSM) on Thursday reported third-quarter profit of $23.86 billion.
The results surpassed Wall Street expectations.
why_it_matters_hint: TSMC is a read-through for demand for AI chips.
